mode3_site_plan.source_context: Clovis NM Plumbers is a referral service that connects Clovis homeowners with licensed local plumbers. Clovis sits in Curry County on the eastern New Mexico plains next to Cannon Air Force Base (ZIP 88101): very hard groundwater that scales water heaters and fixtures, winters cold enough to freeze and burst uninsulated pipes, and a large renting and military-family population that needs a plumber the same week they arrive. Always write Clovis, NM -- Clovis, California is a different and much larger city.
